---
"@zeno-lib/db": minor
"@zeno-lib/schema": minor
---

Column rules. `serverOwned(builder)` and `withRule(builder, refinement)` from `@zeno-lib/db/schema` mark a column inside `table`, `unsecureTable` or `schema(...).table`, and `defineTableSchema` reads the marks: a server-owned column leaves `insert` and `update`, and a rule applies to both, under any refinement passed in the options. `select` keeps every column, without the rules. The table functions change no DDL.

**Breaking:** `defineTableSchema` now leaves identity columns, `generated by default` ones included, out of `insert` and `update`. A form or action that names a row extends its schema with `select.shape.id`, which keeps the positive check.
